comment: Narrowed to separation 4 to 6 (proposed). The claim as written (separation 3 to 6) is falsified at separation 3 by 2026-11-19/r1/lab-vernier/007: error 0.181, T = 2; the pair closes to about 0.17 and the power law with no core misses the passage. That falsification stands and is not cited here. Four in-domain runs of mine support the proposed range, each with the paper predict() at error at or below 0.03: r1/002 (separation 4, error 0.00532), r1/003 (separation 6, 0.00523), r2/007 (separation 5, 0.00493) and r3/004 (separation 4 diagonal, 0.00525; free fit K = 17.70, the paper has 17.7). Caveats: (a) separation 6 constrains K weakly and is also passed with no force (zero-force error 0.014), so the upper end rests on separations 4 and 5; (b) the separation-4 pass depends on the paper integrator step because the pair approaches contact by T = 2; (c) the separation-4 result is orientation-independent (horizontal r1/002 and diagonal r3/004 agree). Zero-force errors: r1/002 0.049, r3/004 0.049, r2/007 0.023. Lone-A runs are not cited.
